name: PVE-UPS
description: PVE-UPS is a web-based UPS shutdown appliance for Proxmox VE. It monitors UPS devices via SNMP (RFC 1628 or vendor MIB) or NUT and automatically shuts down Proxmox hosts during power outages, replacing vendor-locked solutions like APC PowerChute.

notes.text: Set a password and configure your Proxmox API token (requires Sys.PowerMgmt privilege) through the first-access setup wizard at http://CT-IP:8080.
Requires a UPS with an SNMP network card (RFC 1628 or a vendor MIB such as APC PowerNet) or a reachable NUT server on TCP port 3493.
